title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.23982v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, hard to observe, and benefits mainly someone else. Building on Holmstr\"om's model of moral hazard in teams, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a theory-grounded controlled experimental paradigm that instantiates this hidden-action structure as a textual environment for language agents. In each episode, an agent chooses between keeping an immediate local reward and paying a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate eleven open-weight language models and three frontier API models, decomposing behavior into query rate, realized information transfer, local-reward preservation, unsafe choice, format validity, and team success. The frontier policies differ sharply: Fable 5 moves from querying toward local reward as cost rises and back toward querying as team reward rises, yet remains query-sat

translated_title: 多智能体语言模型中的道德风险
translated_abstract: 当对社会有价值的努力成本高昂、难以观察且主要惠及他人时，合作可能会失败。基于Holmström的团队道德风险模型，我们引入了对话道德风险博弈，这是一种理论支撑的受控实验范式，将这种隐藏行动结构实例化为语言代理的文本环境。在每个回合中，代理需要在保留即时本地奖励和支付查询成本以揭示主要帮助另一个代理下游决策的隐藏安全事实之间做出选择。我们评估了十一个开放权重语言模型和三个前沿API模型，将行为分解为查询率、实现的信息传递、本地奖励保留、不安全选择、格式有效性和团队成功。前沿策略差异显著：Fable 5在成本上升时从查询转向本地奖励，在团队奖励上升时又回到查询，但仍保持查询饱和状态。
tldr: 本文提出对话道德风险博弈实验范式，揭示多智能体语言模型在隐藏行动下的合作失败机制，并发现前沿模型在成本与奖励变化下的策略性查询行为差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game paradigm, revealing cooperation failures in multi-agent language models under hidden actions, and finding distinct strategic querying behaviors of frontier models in response to cost and reward changes.
